sources: Codenames: Harry Potter rulebook (USAopoly / CGE, via RulesPal)

modules.name: Mission Log
modules.note: Campaign of missions with their own turn and mistake limits.

steps.text: Partners sit on opposite sides of the table
Shuffle the Code cards; deal {n} into a 5 x 5 grid
steps.note: First games: use only the picture or only the word side

steps.text: Red Order of the Phoenix cards and the blue Death Eater card within reach
{n} Time-Turner tokens Ministry Official side up as the time bank; teal extras stay in the box
steps.note: Add the 11th / 12th token to make it easier

steps.text: Mission tokens: first number = Time-Turner tokens in the bank; only the second number of them Ministry Official side up, the rest flipped
Stand beside the grid; draw a random Key card into it so each player sees only their side (wider than tall)
steps.note: Draw from the middle of a vertically held deck

steps.text: Find all 15 Order of the Phoenix members before time runs out
Guessing a Death Eater from your partner's side loses immediately
Either partner gives the first one-word clue for their red cards
